title: polypodium robustum subsp. caespitosum
intro: Polypodium robustum subsp. caespitosum, commonly known as Mountain Maidenhair, is a species of fern belonging to the Polypodiaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Polypodium robustum subsp. caespitosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
